jobs.description:
Are you technically inclined and eager to work in a dynamic production environment where you can continuously develop yourself? Then this position as an assembly worker in a 2-shift system might be something for you!

Your role
As an assembly worker, you play an important role in the production process of seating solutions, such as chairs for, among others, De Lijn. You will start with an intensive training program where you will get familiar with various assembly techniques. This way, you build the knowledge and skills to grow into a true specialist.

Responsibilities
Assembling parts for car seats according to technical instructions
Covering cushions with fabric or leather
Performing visual quality checks on finished products
Identifying and reporting errors or deviations
- Vaardigheden:
You have technical insight, from your school background, previous work experiences, or from a technical hobby. 
You can handle the heat well, as you'll be working in a warm environment.
You're eager to learn and ready to get your hands dirty.

- Attesten:
/

- Opleidingsvereisten:
A technical education is a plus, but not required.

- Vakkennis:
You have some initial experience in assembly.

- Talenkennis:
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or a good knowledge of English. Either one is enough!

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As an operator, you will be responsible for 1 of 2 automatic packaging lines.

 
• 
You carry out checks on the food products that are introduced.

 
• 
You also set various parameters so that the right product ends up in the right packaging.

 
• 
Furthermore, you have to monitor the smooth operation of your packaging line.

 
• 
In case of technical failures, you are the first person who tries to solve this. For major malfunctions, you coordinate with the person in charge.

 
• 
The checks on the finished product are also done by you.

 
• 
All this in a team with a co-operator and 2 forklift drivers.

Read on quickly below and find out if you qualify:

 
• 
You have experience in setting up machines (it is a vertical packaging machine).

 
• 
You have a good technical knowledge.

 
• 
You speak good English and Dutch

 
• 
Experience as a forklift operator or forklift certificate is a plus.

 
• 
You highly value safety.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

Life on the team

We are looking for a motivated Customer Executive with at least 1 year of experience to join our growing team. This is a newly created position driven by our continued business growth.

You are the main point of contact for customers, suppliers, and internal teams, ensuring a smooth customer experience throughout pre-sales, order management, and post-sales processes.

What you’ll do

• Act as the main point of contact for customers, suppliers, and internal teams
• Take ownership of the end-to-end customer experience, ensuring high service quality
• Co-ordinating quotations and orders with internal teams and monitoring performance
• Ensure delivery in line with customer service levels
• Is responsible for pricing and margin checks, ensuring alignment with key stakeholders
• Oversee customer stock management and collaborate with teams to optimize levels
• Manage customer deployment schedules and order instructions accurately
• Ensure orders and invoice queries are resolved in a timely manner

 

What you’ll need

• 0-2+ years of experience in customer service (B2B environment is a plus) or internal sales
• Proactive customer focus and communication skills (written and verbal)
• Good organizational skills and attention to detail
• Ability to take ownership and solve problems proactively
• Good understanding of business processes and customer expectations
• Fluent in English + Dutch and/or French
• Ability to work in team environment
• Demonstrates a growth mindset with a strong willingness to learn and continuously improve

Barman — Nando
 

Where Italian nostalgia meets real bar craft
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant — it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Barman to own our bar: someone who mixes with precision, keeps the bar running like clockwork during service, and makes every guest feel like they've pulled up a stool at Nonna's counter.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Prepare and serve drinks — cocktails, wine, coffee, aperitivo classics — accurately and efficiently 

• Welcome guests at the bar and set the tone for their evening 

• Keep the bar stocked, clean, and ready before service hits 

• Manage the pace of orders during busy periods without losing quality or friendliness 

• Coordinate with the floor team so drinks and food orders stay in sync 

• Handle guest requests and resolve minor issues with a calm, professional touch  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a barman/bartender in hospitality 

• Solid knowledge of classic cocktails, wine, and Italian aperitivo culture 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, hygiene- and detail-conscious 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €15.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real ownership of the bar from day one  

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.

As a production worker, you will join a food manufacturing company where you will assist in the meat smoking production process. Your responsibilities include loading the products into the smoking machine, operating the machine, and placing the finished products back onto the correct racks after processing. At the end of each working day, you will also be responsible for cleaning the work area and the equipment.

You will work from Monday untill Friday from 5:15 until the work is done (about 13h or 13h30). You will work 38h a week.

The salary for this position is €17.45 per hour, plus a shift allowance.

We are looking for people who speak basic English and Polish.

• You have knowledge of basic Polish and basis English
• You can work from 5h15 in the morning
• You are willing to work in food industry

Are you technically skilled, detail-oriented, and looking for a varied role in a warm, family-owned company? Then this position as Mould Technician could be the perfect fit for you!

In this role, you will be responsible for the correct assembly and disassembly of moulds. Every changeover is carried out with great attention to detail and in line with established procedures, ensuring that all equipment remains in perfect condition. Careful handling and precision are key.

After a thorough onboarding period and once you have gained sufficient experience, you will also be responsible for restarting machines after a changeover. In addition, you will support the mould department with various tasks such as:

• Maintenance and repair of moulds

• Assembling and fine-tuning moulds

• Providing general technical support

• No two days are the same!

• Strong mechanical knowledge is essential

• Able to work very precisely and neatly

• Experience in a similar technical role is an advantage

• Skilled in setting up production machines and tools

• Able to plan efficiently and set priorities, both independently and in a team

• Methodical approach, following procedures with an eye for improvement

• Quick to analyse, report, and adjust when needed

• Positive, constructive attitude

• Good command of English is required, as one colleague communicates exclusively in English

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?
Then this might be your new challenge!

You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.

As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.

- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.
- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.

- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.

You enjoy active work.

- Attesten:
Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
No diploma required.

- Talenkennis:
Good knowledge of English

Our client is a leading manufacturer of modified plastics with a strong presence across Asia. The company operates manufacturing facilities, R&D centers, and sales offices recognised among the top modified plastics manufacturers in China, the organisation is a market leader in automotive PC/ABS and ABS materials, delivering innovative and sustainable material solutions to global B2B customers.

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and manage relationships with existing customers while identifying new business opportunities within automotive and industrial sectors.
• Promote and provide technical consultation on plastic material solutions, including PC/ABS, ABS, recycled plastics, and functional materials.
• Conduct customer visits, understand project requirements, and coordinate with internal technical and production teams to deliver solutions.
• Prepare sales forecasts, quotations, business proposals, and negotiate commercial terms with customers.
• Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer demands to support business growth and market expansion.

To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Patsorn Asawasangrut at +66 2 012 5069.

• Experience in Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles.
• Background from plastics, polymer, chemical, or related manufacturing industries.
• Fluent in Chinese is mandatory and good communication in English.
• Korean or Japanese language skills will be considered an advantage.
• Junior-level candidates from any industry with a strong interest in technical sales are welcome to apply.
• Senior-level candidates should have direct experience in plastics, polymer materials, or related industrial products.
• Strong communication, customer relationship management, negotiation, and business development skills.

Are you passionate about securing large-scale cloud environments and driving security by design? We are looking for a Security Cloud Architect to join the CISO Office and play a key role in shaping and governing cloud security across the organisation's cloud transformation journey.

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor and technical authority on cloud security, helping engineering teams build secure solutions while ensuring security risks are effectively managed. You will define cloud security standards, guardrails, reference architectures, and reusable security patterns, with a strong focus on AWS and exposure to Azure environments.

You will be responsible for reviewing and challenging solution designs, conducting threat modelling and architecture risk assessments, defining remediation plans, and ensuring security controls are aligned with business and regulatory requirements. Working closely with architects, engineers, security operations, and risk teams, you will help strengthen cloud security capabilities across the organisation.

We're looking for an experienced cloud security professional with a strong background in AWS security architecture, including IAM, network security, container security (EKS/ECS), DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code (TerraForm/CloudFormation), cryptography, logging and monitoring, and AWS security services such as Guardduty, Security Hub, Inspector, WAF, and KMS.

• 10+ years of experience in IT and Cybersecurity

• 5+ years of hands-on Cloud Security Architecture experience

• Strong expertise in AWS security architecture (Azure is a plus)

• Experience defining Cloud Security Control Frameworks and security standards

• Proven experience with threat modelling, security assessments, and risk management

• Knowledge of NIS2, ISO 27001, CIS, and NIST frameworks

• AWS Security Specialty certification is highly desirable

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Fluent English

 

This is an excellent opportunity for a senior cloud security expert who enjoys combining strategic architecture, governance, and hands-on technical security expertise in a modern cloud-first environment.

For our client, an international organization in Heverlee , we are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead the AP team. In this key role, you will ensure the accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, maintain compliance with accounting and tax regulations and drive continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead, coach, and develop the Accounts Payable team.
• Oversee the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
• Coordinate invoice processing, payment runs, and AP-related financial controls.
• Manage monthly closing activities, reconciliations, accruals, and follow-up of outstanding items.
• Ensure compliance with VAT, tax, and internal accounting policies.
• Act as the main point of contact for AP-related matters across multiple stakeholders.
• Identify and implement process improvements, standardization initiatives, and automation opportunities.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent through experience.
• Several years of experience in Accounts Payable within a multinational or complex organization.
• Strong SAP knowledge; experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus.
• Solid understanding of VAT and accounting regulations.
• Proven experience leading and developing teams.
• Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

jobs.occupation: Operator Automotive | Protection & Finishing of New Vehicles
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities

 
• Clean and prepare vehicles before treatment
 
• Mask components that should not be coated
 
• Apply protective coatings using professional spraying equipment
 
• Perform quality checks on finished vehicles
 
• Report any irregularities or defects
 
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

Who Are We Looking For?

 
• You enjoy physical and hands-on work
 
• You have an eye for detail and take pride in delivering quality work
 
• You communicate fluently in either English or Dutch
 
• You hold a valid Category B driving licence and are comfortable driving both manual and automatic vehicles
 
• You are reliable, eager to learn, and enjoy working as part of a team
 
• Experience in automotive, production, vehicle maintenance, bodywork, or spray painting is an advantage, but not required

For a company that designs, integrates, and maintains logistics automation solutions to optimize internal logistics processes in warehouses, production, and distribution
 

Your Responsibilities:
 

 
• Maintenance, repair, and installation of complex warehouse automation systems.
 
• Ensure smooth operation of our installations by performing timely maintenance and resolving technical issues quickly and efficiently.
 
• Analyze malfunctions and resolve them independently, with an eye for safety and customer satisfaction.
 
• Work mostly independently, but be a team player when necessary.
 
• Report your interventions in our system to ensure and improve quality. 

 
• Diploma in electromechanics, electricity, and/or mechanics.
 
• Basic knowledge of automation is a plus, such as knowledge of SCADA, use of multimeters.
 
• Several years of experience in a technical role is a plus.
 
• Work independently, accurately, and customer-oriented.
 
• Fluent communication in Dutch and/or English.
 
• No fear of heights; our work takes place at different levels.
 
• Good physical condition for physical work.
 
• Flexible and willing to work occasionally outside standard hours.
 
• Motivated, responsible, and keep administration tidy.
 
• Eager to learn and share a passion for technology.
 
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, PLC control systems; if this appeals to you, this job is for you.
 
• All-round PC skills and experience with CMMS systems, (Sprocket).
 
• “You are open to working weekends.

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.
 

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.
 

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.
 

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
 
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
 
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
 
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
 
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
 
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
 
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
 
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
 
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations. 

 
• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
 
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
 
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
 
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
 
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
 
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
 
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
 
• Good physical fitness.
 
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
 
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts
